description: Generate NatSpec documentation for a Solidity file with kritisi. By default the documented source is returned without touching any file. Set write=true for an in-place update with a .sol.bak backup, or set output to write to a separate file.

output.description: Write the documented source to this path (implies writing)

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing output file

write.description: Update the source file in place and keep a .sol.bak backup

name: natspec_document
title: Add NatSpec documentation
